about: Places the printed Study Quran starts a new paragraph where its capture ran two paragraphs together and lost the stop between them, each read off the printed page (see breaks.mjs): by hand, or, where the capture kept the stop, from the set-in first line the page gives every paragraph (see indents.mjs), with a sample checked on the page pictures. print: a fingerprint of the words around the spot, never the words. stop: the mark put back, a full stop unless given, empty where the capture kept it, a closing bracket where the capture lost that instead. page: the captured page image the spot was read on.
